title: Character & Integrity
intro: A baby has no character to speak of yet, and is absorbing ours at an alarming rate. This month is honest about that. It is mostly a prayer for the parents — that what this child copies would be worth copying, and that the home they learn honesty in would deserve their trust.

keyScriptures.text: The righteous lead blameless lives; blessed are their children after them.
These commandments are to be on your hearts. Impress them on your children.

weeks.title: You Will Copy Us
weeks.declaration: You will learn how to be a person by watching people. That is a frightening privilege and we accept it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, make us worth copying. Where we are not, protect this child from learning it. Amen.

weeks.title: A Home Where Truth Is Safe
weeks.declaration: This will be a house where the truth is safe to say. That has to be built before you can speak.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make honesty easy here. Let our child never need to lie to us. Amen.

weeks.title: Kept Promises
weeks.declaration: We will keep our small promises to you. That is how you will learn that words mean something.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, make us reliable in the small things. Let our child grow up trusting words. Amen.

weeks.title: Sorry Said Out Loud
weeks.declaration: You will hear us apologise. That is deliberate, because you will need to know how.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give us the humility to say sorry in front of our child. Amen.

days.title: You Will Copy Us
days.declaration: You will learn to be a person by watching people. We are trying to be worth watching.

scripture.text: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

days.title: Truth Is Safe Here
days.declaration: This is a house where the truth is safe. You will never need to lie to us.

scripture.text: Each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully.

days.title: Promises Kept
days.declaration: We will keep our small promises. That is how you learn words mean something.

scripture.text: Let your yes be yes, and your no be no.

days.title: Sorry Out Loud
days.declaration: You will hear us apologise. You will need to know how it is done.

scripture.text: Confess your sins to each other.

days.title: The Same at Home
days.declaration: We will try to be the same people at home as everywhere else. You will notice if we are not.

scripture.text: I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.

days.title: Gentle Under Pressure
days.declaration: May you learn from us that tiredness is not permission to be unkind.

scripture.text: Clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

days.title: Honest About Ourselves
days.declaration: We will not pretend to be better than we are. You would see through it anyway.

scripture.text: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper.

days.title: Fair
days.declaration: May you grow up expecting fairness because you were treated fairly.

scripture.text: Act justly, love mercy, walk humbly with your God.

days.title: Words Used Carefully
days.declaration: The words spoken over you are chosen carefully. They are building something.

scripture.text: The tongue has the power of life and death.

days.title: Small Things Done Properly
days.declaration: May you learn to do small things properly, because you watched us do them.

scripture.text: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.

days.title: No Secrets That Harm
days.declaration: There will be no secrets in this house that hurt you. You will always be told the truth.

scripture.text: The truth will set you free.

days.title: Trustworthy Grown-Ups
days.declaration: May every adult who holds you be trustworthy. May you learn what safe adults are like.

scripture.text: Whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous.

days.title: Blessed After Us
days.declaration: What is built in us gets handed to you. That is a reason to keep building.

scripture.text: Blessed are their children after them.

days.title: Corrected Kindly
days.declaration: When you are corrected, it will be done kindly. Correction is not the same as rejection.

scripture.text: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful.

days.title: Not Shamed
days.declaration: You will be corrected but never shamed. There is a difference and we intend to keep it.

scripture.text: There is now no condemnation.

days.title: Work Done Well
days.declaration: May you see work done well in this house, and think that is normal.

scripture.text: Work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord.

days.title: Money Handled Honestly
days.declaration: May you grow up in a house where money is handled honestly. You will learn more than we teach.

scripture.text: Accurate weights find favour with him.

days.title: Generous by Default
days.declaration: May giving be normal to you because you never saw it as unusual.

scripture.text: God loves a cheerful giver.

days.title: Kept Confidences
days.declaration: May you learn that some things are not repeated, from people who did not repeat them.

scripture.text: A trustworthy person keeps a secret.

days.title: Nothing Performed
days.declaration: We are not raising you for an audience. What happens here does not need witnesses.

scripture.text: Be careful not to practise your righteousness in front of others.

days.title: Kindness When Unseen
days.declaration: May you become someone who is kind when nobody is looking, because that is what you saw.

scripture.text: Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.

days.title: Character Over Cleverness
days.declaration: We would rather you be good than impressive, if it ever comes to a choice.

scripture.text: The Lord looks at the heart.

days.title: Steady Rather Than Perfect
days.declaration: We will not be perfect parents. We intend to be steady ones.

scripture.text: His love endures forever.

days.title: A Good Name to Inherit
days.declaration: We are trying to leave you a good name. It is worth more than anything else we could.

scripture.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches.

days.title: Forgiveness Practised Here
days.declaration: Forgiveness will be normal in this house. You will need it and you will give it.

scripture.text: Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

days.title: Boundaries That Are Kind
days.declaration: You will be given limits, and they are a form of love rather than a lack of it.

scripture.text: The Lord disciplines those he loves.

days.title: Honest About Hard Things
days.declaration: When something is hard, we will say so rather than pretend. You will learn that honesty is survivable.

scripture.text: We do not want you to be uninformed about the troubles we experienced.

days.title: Faithful in Ordinary Weeks
days.declaration: Most of character is ordinary weeks done properly. That is what you will see.

scripture.text: Make it your ambition to lead a quiet life.

days.title: Built to Hold Weight
days.declaration: What is being built in you now has to hold weight later. We are building slowly.

scripture.text: The wise man built his house on the rock.

days.title: Grace When We Fail
days.declaration: We will get this wrong. There is grace for us, and you will see us take it.

scripture.text: My grace is sufficient for you.

days.title: Handed Down
days.declaration: Everything good in this house is meant to be handed to you. That is the whole point.

scripture.text: We will tell the next generation.
